about: What can be looked at, by the question it answers. A plug-in's layers and analyses name their lens in its manifest ("lens"); nothing else in the shell orders them. Each lens draws a small glyph of its own (src/shell/lenses.js).

lenses.title: People
lenses.question: who lives here, and how it has grown

lenses.title: Movement
lenses.question: how it moves, and what it can reach

lenses.title: Fabric
lenses.question: what it is made of and what it does

lenses.title: Risk
lenses.question: what threatens it, and what is exposed

lenses.title: Change
lenses.question: how its record unfolds in time
